data.description: Build a layered responsive testing system that validates every route across accurate width/height, touch/hover, orientation, browser-engine, text-scaling, and safe-area conditions; add real Android/iOS device-cloud execution rather than relying on Chrome presets; reconcile prior FRAC-11 browser-gate work; use the suite to validate and repair the homepage hero clipping on Galaxy S24-class short visible viewports; document secrets and physical-device release acceptance.
data.title: Real-device responsive test system and mobile hero validation

data.body: Pre-fix red proof captured before Hero edits at a simulated touch/mobile 360x640 visual viewport (DPR 3): document scrollWidth 376 > clientWidth 360 (16px horizontal overflow); Hero is forced to 640px high; absolute mobile footer occupies y=460.125..640 (179.875px); Story CTA occupies y=558..608. Screenshot: /tmp/frac17-pre-red-galaxy-class.png. This is local simulation evidence only, not a real-device pass.

Implementation complete. Core gates passed: pnpm typecheck, pnpm test (157 tests), pnpm build, pnpm conformance, and pnpm test:e2e:fast (119 cases: 105 passed, 14 annotated skips). The credential preflight correctly exits 2 when BrowserStack secrets are absent. Physical Android/iOS execution and Samsung Internet release evidence remain unrun because no BrowserStack credentials/device access are configured.

REVIEW OUTCOME: implementation-level rework needed. Cold review of fd81617 against the complete FRAC-17 plan. Blocking findings: (1) tests/e2e/responsive.spec.ts:9-13 skips known 320px failures on Protocol/Library/People and every non-Home 200% text-stress route; FRAC-18 records actual overflows up to 315px, so FRAC-17's all-route/no-horizontal-overflow/text-reflow acceptance is not green. (2) tests/e2e/hero-responsive.spec.ts:30-34 gates initial visual-viewport containment on local profile metadata; the remote project in playwright.config.ts:25-27 has no profile, so a physical Galaxy run never asserts that footer/CTA/arrow fit the measured initial visualViewport—the central regression can false-green remotely. (3) tests/e2e/support/layout-assertions.ts:84-91 only checks generic Android-or-iOS/touch/non-hover/DPR; it does not verify each configured platform's Android vs iPhone vs iPad/Safari/OS characteristics, so device/project fallback or mismatch is not self-detected as required. (4) The two specs do not implement required navbar structural/first-content occlusion, general content/card/media/footer overlap/clipping, portrait-landscape rotation without reload, touch drag/swipe/single navigation, reduced-motion freeze, browser-chrome collapse/expand metrics, or deterministic engine-specific visual baselines. BrowserStack configs/docs and missing-secret preflight are candid and no secrets were found, but physical S24 Chrome/iPhone/iPad runs and Samsung Internet release evidence remain unverified and therefore cannot satisfy final completion. Verification: git diff --check clean; pnpm typecheck PASS; targeted Playwright Hero suite PASS (9/9: simulated Chromium 360x640, 640x360, and 390x844 at 200% root text). Initial sandbox port bind failed with EPERM, then the same test passed outside the sandbox. No implementation files changed.

Review-cycle-1 rework complete. Removed all route/text overflow skips and fixed compact/200% sources (Protocol carpet sizing, ArchiveSearch hidden measurement containment, carousel paint/control containment, semantic text wrapping, People CTA). Added exact BrowserStack device/session identity, orientation and visualViewport checks; local rotation, trusted touch/pan-y/scroll, navbar/content, reduced-motion, browser-bar evidence, and platform-neutral visual baselines. Green: pnpm typecheck; pnpm test (157); pnpm build; pnpm conformance; pnpm test:e2e:fast (141 passed, 35 narrow profile-inapplicable skips); 4/4 visual baseline comparison. BrowserStack/Samsung Internet remain unrun because credentials/physical access are absent.

REVIEW OUTCOME: PASS — no remaining implementation-level blocker. Cold review of fd81617 + 19e715b against the complete plan and Review Cycle 1 findings. Broad route/text exemptions are gone; all 9 rendered routes execute at 320/360/200% profiles, and compact/zoom source repairs are covered. Remote portrait Hero containment reads the live visualViewport. BrowserStack platform names correctly become Playwright project names; the official executor-shaped getSessionDetails call validates configured device, OS version, browser/UA family, touch/non-hover/DPR, and orientation. Rotation, trusted CDP touch rotation, pan-y ownership plus real scroll, navbar/content clearance, reduced-motion freeze, explicit browser-bar observed-or-inconclusive evidence, and host-neutral Chromium baselines are executable. The 35 skips are only profile-inapplicable tests: 2 desktop CTA, 7 rotation, 7 touch, 7 reduced motion, 8 remote-only browser-bar, and 4 non-visual profiles; none skip a route or text condition. Verification: git diff --check PASS; pnpm typecheck PASS; pnpm conformance PASS; pnpm test:e2e:fast PASS (141 passed, 35 skipped, all 4 visual-profile comparisons green); no committed BrowserStack credential found. Physical BrowserStack Galaxy/iPhone/iPad sessions and Samsung Internet evidence remain absent because credentials/device access are unavailable; classify that as a human dependency before full completion, not code rework. No implementation files changed.

Need: configure BROWSERSTACK_USERNAME and BROWSERSTACK_ACCESS_KEY with Automate Mobile access, run the committed real-device smoke/full lanes, and complete the documented Galaxy S24 Samsung Internet/browser-bar physical release protocol. Implementation and independent code review pass; do not mark complete until evidence is linked.

Post-review exhaustive matrix found a Firefox-only harness false positive: inline anchors have rendered width but clientWidth=0, so the integrity assertion misclassified every inline link as clipped. Reopened to require a measurable content box before scrollWidth comparison; no page-source regression observed.

Post-review exhaustive engine validation complete. Chromium all-profile projects passed before the Firefox diagnostic boundary; after correcting Firefox inline clientWidth=0 semantics, all remaining Firefox and WebKit projects passed (736 passed, 232 profile-inapplicable skips) and targeted Firefox 320 route sweep passed 14/14. Combined maintained matrix: 1,110 passed and 342 narrow skips across 1,452 cases, with no route/text profile skipped. Typecheck and diff check remain green.

REVIEW OUTCOME: PASS — no implementation-level rework needed. Independent focused review of d4f269a and assertPrimaryContentIntegrity. The clientWidth <= 0 guard correctly excludes Firefox inline anchors that have rendered getBoundingClientRect width but no CSS content box, so their scrollWidth is not a meaningful clipping comparison. It does not conceal actual page overflow: assertNoHorizontalOverflow still independently asserts documentElement and body scrollWidth against the viewport, checks every visible body element bounding box against viewport edges, and inspects positive-width scroll containers; assertPrimaryContentIntegrity still applies scrollWidth > clientWidth + 1 to every tracked primary element with a measurable positive clientWidth. Verification: git show --check d4f269a PASS; pnpm typecheck PASS; targeted PW_MATRIX=full Firefox phone-320x568 responsive suite PASS 14/14 across all rendered routes and redirects. Reviewed recorded exhaustive evidence: Chromium completed all projects before the diagnostic boundary; targeted Firefox 320 passed 14/14; remaining Firefox and WebKit passed 736 with 232 narrow profile-inapplicable skips; combined maintained matrix 1,110 passed with 342 narrow skips. Physical BrowserStack real-device sessions and Galaxy S24 Samsung Internet/browser-bar protocol remain an explicit human dependency before full completion, not code rework. No implementation files changed and task status was not changed.

Final code review PASS after exhaustive Chromium/Firefox/WebKit matrix. Remaining need is unchanged: add BrowserStack Automate Mobile credentials, execute and link real Galaxy S24/iPhone/iPad sessions, then complete Samsung Internet and browser-bar physical checks before marking done.

Human decision: do not use paid BrowserStack. Replace the physical device-cloud dependency with free local Android Studio emulators and Apple iOS Simulator, including browser chrome/system-bar-aware validation and reproducible setup documentation. Preserve Playwright as the broad regression layer.

Revised plan replaces paid BrowserStack with a free local simulator layer: Appium 3 + WebdriverIO drives Android 14 Chrome AVDs and iOS/iPadOS Mobile Safari simulators; existing Playwright matrix/Hero repair stay intact. Host audit: Apple Silicon and disk are sufficient, but full Xcode/iOS runtimes and Android Studio/SDK/JDK/AVDs are currently absent. Plan isolates one-time App Store/license/Setup Wizard gates, removes provider secrets/tunnels, shares runner-neutral geometry probes, captures whole-screen browser/system chrome evidence, and labels all results virtual rather than physical Galaxy/iPhone/iPad proof.

Simulator-pivot implementation complete in 836a199. Removed all BrowserStack/provider configs, dependency, scripts, secrets, and CI; preserved Hero fixes and desktop Playwright matrix; added shared runner-neutral probes plus exact-pinned Appium/WebdriverIO doctor/setup/orchestrator/evidence harness for Android Emulator and Apple Simulator. Validation: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile PASS; typecheck PASS; Vitest 157/157 PASS; build PASS; conformance PASS; fast Playwright 141 passed/27 expected skips/0 failed; exhaustive matrix completed 1108 passed/276 expected skips with two WebKit desktop-text route timeouts after the host was idle for hours, and both /library and /people passed immediately in a clean serial rerun (2/2). Provider-reference and diff audits PASS. Appium 3.5.2, UiAutomator2 8.1.0, XCUITest 11.17.7, and WebdriverIO 9.29.1 are installed in the ignored repository-local cache. Genuine host prerequisites remain for simulator execution: install/first-launch full Xcode, select it, install an iOS runtime, create the named compact/notched/iPad simulators and clear Safari first-run; complete Android Studio SDK setup (platform-tools, emulator, latest CLI tools), create the named API-34 S24-class/tablet AVDs, and clear Chrome first-run. Java/JBR is present. The runner preflight exits cleanly with those exact actions and no SDK/license side effects.

REVIEW OUTCOME: implementation-level rework needed. Cold review of 836a199 and 70d0827 against the simulator-pivot plan found three code gaps. (1) scripts/mobile-simulators/doctor.mjs:57-150 and setup-appium.mjs:7-71 do not validate CLI selections. Confirmed: doctor --platform nonsense --profile missing --json exits 0 with ok:true and Ready semantics, and setup-appium --platform nonsense installs/checks zero drivers then reports ready. Reject unknown platforms, missing option values, unknown profiles, and cross-family profile selections. (2) doctor.mjs:71-114 treats any simulator/AVD with the configured display name as sufficient. It does not inspect iOS deviceTypeIdentifier or an Android AVD config/system-image package, API, ABI, size/density, so a wrongly named device can pass the required preflight; these checks happen only partially after boot. The plan requires doctor to validate the declared runtime/device type/image before a run. (3) suite.mjs:166-183 and 314-319 does not enforce the retained error/asset contract in simulator sessions. It collects browser logs once at the end but never fails on severe entries; it has no per-route page-error or first-party resource failure probe, so Android Chrome can produce a passing manifest despite errors that fail Playwright. Add a runner-neutral serializable error/resource probe or equivalent supported adapter enforcement, with unsupported channels explicit. Paid BrowserStack configs/SDK/secrets/tunnel/CI references are otherwise removed; exact-pinned Appium/WebdriverIO drivers, ignored caches/evidence, shared geometry probes, identity/viewport checks, docs terminology, and process ownership/cleanup look sound. Verification PASS: git diff --check; node --check all new mjs; typecheck; Vitest 157/157; build; conformance; fast Playwright 141 passed/27 narrow skips; isolated WebKit desktop-text /library, /people and redirect cases 4/4, supporting that the two exhaustive timeouts were host flake. Expected-failure behavior PASS: all-host doctor reports precise Xcode/iOS and Android SDK/AVD actions; Android run exits before build/process startup; Appium driver doctor reports missing SDK without downloading or accepting licenses; ports 4173/4723 are clear afterward. Completion is additionally blocked on operator first-run setup: full Xcode plus iOS runtime/named devices/Safari first-run, and Android SDK tools/API-34 named AVDs/Chrome first-run are absent, so no actual simulator screenshots/manifests exist yet. Leave FRAC-17 in review for implementation rework; after code re-review, route the genuine host setup dependency to needs_human rather than claiming simulator completion.

Review-cycle-1 simulator rework complete. Strict shared selection parsing now rejects unknown, empty, and cross-family platform/profile values in doctor, setup, and run before side effects. Doctor/run validate CoreSimulator device type plus installed runtime and Android AVD config/runtime image, API, ABI, resolution, and density. Appium sessions now enforce route-scoped page/console/first-party-asset health; Android requires browser logs and Apple records unsupported log transport while retaining in-page enforcement. Green: syntax/diff checks; simulators:self-test including serialized Chromium health failures; all 9 CLI negative cases exit 2; typecheck; Vitest 157/157; build; conformance; fast Playwright 141 passed/27 expected skips. Valid Android run stops at exact absent SDK/AVD actions and leaves ports 4173/4723 clear. Full Xcode/iOS runtime and Android SDK/AVDs remain the genuine operator setup dependency.

REVIEW OUTCOME: implementation-level rework needed. Cold review of d617d3e against the revised FRAC-17 plan and Review Cycle 1 findings.

Closed findings: (1) unknown, missing, empty, and cross-family platform/profile selectors now fail with exit 2 before setup/run side effects; all exercised negative doctor/setup/run cases behaved correctly. (2) Apple doctor/runtime identity validates the named CoreSimulator device type and iOS runtime, and Android doctor validates the declared AVD config package, API, ABI, size, and density. (3) simulator navigation now enforces route-scoped in-page page/console/first-party-asset health; Android additionally requires the browser-log transport, while Apple records unsupported-by-driver truthfully and retains the in-page enforcement.

Remaining blockers:
1. Android runtime image identity is not enforced. scripts/mobile-simulators/run.mjs records identity.systemImage, but scripts/mobile-simulators/identity.mjs:65-76 never reads it or compares any exact runtime image marker to profile.systemImagePackage; it only accepts any fingerprint containing "google". Direct negative proof: validateAndroidRuntimeIdentity returned ok:true when identity.systemImage was "not-the-declared-play-store-image". This leaves the reviewed requirement ("declared AVD image ... in doctor and runtime") false-green for a stale/already-booted or wrong Google API-34 image. Add an exact, executable runtime/image-family assertion (including Play Store vs generic Google APIs) and a negative self-test.
2. Valid profile-only selection is not honored by doctor/run. runDoctor derives wantsAndroid/wantsIos from platformName, so  also performs and requires full Xcode/iOS checks, despite profilesFor selecting only the Android profile. Derive requested families from the selected profile set, as setup-appium already does, and self-test the single-profile path.

Verification: pnpm simulators:self-test PASS outside the macOS Chromium sandbox; nine representative invalid CLI cases exit 2; Android profile doctor and valid run fail before build/services with precise absent SDK/AVD remediation; ports 4173/4723 clear afterward; pnpm typecheck PASS; pnpm test:e2e:fast PASS (141 passed, 27 expected profile-inapplicable skips); git diff --check PASS. Current-source BrowserStack config/SDK/script/secret references are absent (historical Lattice text excluded), and no browserstack-node-sdk lock/package entry remains. Full Xcode/iOS runtime and Android SDK/AVDs remain a genuine operator setup dependency after code rework. No implementation files changed; leave FRAC-17 in review.

Review comment correction for finding 2: the omitted command is pnpm simulators:doctor -- --profile android-emulator-s24-class. That valid profile-only invocation incorrectly includes required full-Xcode, iOS-runtime, and XCUITest checks.

Review-cycle-2 simulator rework complete. Android runtime validation now proves the declared google_apis_playstore family by requiring the com.android.vending APK path in addition to emulator/AVD/API/ABI/geometry/Google fingerprint checks; pure positive and generic-Google-image negative cases pass. Doctor and Appium setup now derive required OS families from selected profiles, so profile-only Android excludes Xcode/XCUITest and profile-only Apple excludes Android/UiAutomator2, while explicit cross-family doctor/setup/run selections still exit 2. Green: syntax and diff checks; simulators:self-test; focused profile-only doctor/run CLI assertions; cross-family CLI matrix; typecheck; fast Playwright 141 passed/27 expected skips; provider audit. Full Xcode/iOS runtime and Android SDK/AVDs remain the genuine operator setup dependency.
